messages:
Alex: OK this is peak chaos — my mouthguard flew off during the overtime scramble and landed in the communal nacho tray. anyone got tongs? 😅
Maria: omg 😂 bring a new one or we’ll just declare it a sacrifice to the fantasy gods
Raj: also — drafting late tonight. who’s in for a last-minute swap reminder? draft at 7pm PT, right? @Jamie
Jamie: yup 7pm. i can host a 10min pre-draft trash talk sesh in the kitchen. coffee + chili? :coffee: :chili_pepper:
Alex: i'll be there with a spare mouthguard (maybe sanitized?) and a bag of chips. also up for swaps, need a WR or a TE
Raj: offering Chase for my Ekeler straight up? thinking of punting RB depth for WR upside
Maria: no way i'm letting Chase go. also, please no Ekeler trades without a spreadsheet and at least 3 witnesses 😬
Jamie: vote: keep or trade? react with :thumbsup: to keep, :thumbsdown: to trade. gonna count reactions after lunch
ops-bot: Reminder: Fantasy draft tonight at 19:00 PT. Link: https://fantasy.example.com/room/2323 — Join 10 min early for lineup prep
Alex: low-key nervous about the draft order — i always freeze on round 3 picks. any quick tips?
Maria: pre-rank top 20 so you don't overthink. also set an alert for pick timer. and eat beforehand (nachos are optional) :grin:
Raj: also reminder — if anyone trades during the draft channel, ping #support to log it for the league. we had a silent swap last season and i still forgive no one
Jamie: ok see y'all at 6:50 for pre-draft banter. and Alex: save a chip from the nacho tray for posterity (or for science)
Alex: will sacrifice the chip to the fantasy gods. may their RNG be merciful. :pray:
